The $QQQ followed through out of its daily bearish engulfing to the downside on Friday. Here are more recent instances of bearish engulfing candles which also culminated in a break of the 20-EMA:

Not every instance will turn out to be identical. A couple of other factors to consider -

(1) Quality of leadership - are there growth stocks bucking the trend and setting up?

(2) Where are we in the cycle? Early bull or late stage bull?

(3) Closely linked to (1), on the index move back higher, are you seeing stocks in your watchlists improving in price action technically? or is there more deterioration under the hood (which would imply a dead cat bounce)?

The baseline expectation based on past price action is increased volatility and the possibility of a larger correction (7-10%). That said, as traders we have to constantly gauge the market, taking it day by day going forward will keep you out of trouble! 

For long-only traders it's a good time to destress a little bit, but stay focused on **tracking relative strength**, and maintaining those watchlists - stay safe out there!
